On 2026-11-20 the user asked to "work on a1+ Unit 7 same all deal as before none stop all approved": the A1+ Unit 7 map (A1+ 7.Y follows A1 7.Y, one step each, fifteen lessons) approved up front, straight to Preview, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Four new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash), each caught half-way: Sofia pulls on a red coat at a door open onto snow, Diego pulls off a heavy jacket in hot sun, Ana pulls a red glove onto her hand on a snowy street, Luis holds one wet boot he has just pulled off at his door while it rains. Wrong options that swap on and off come with the weather that makes them wrong (It's hot. He's putting on his jacket.); Luis's wrong option names a hat he is not wearing.

lesson.title: 7.5 Put on your coat
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Tell someone to put on or take off clothes (Put on your gloves. / Take off your boots.) and say what someone is doing with them (She's putting on her coat.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.5 Clothes for the Weather: A1 says which clothes the weather needs (It is cold. I need a coat.); A1+ 7.5 puts them on and takes them off. The one new grammar relationship is the two-word verbs put on and take off, as a request (Put on your gloves. / Take off your boots.) and with A1+ 3.3's -ing (She's putting on her coat. / He's taking off his jacket.). Four new photos show the cast mid-way, with the weather that explains it in the photo; 7.2's Why…? Because… and 7.4's It's snowing./It's raining. give the reason.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 7.5 coat, gloves, boots; A1 7.3 jacket and hat; A1+ 3.3 he's/she's + -ing; A1+ 7.2 Why…? Because…; A1+ 7.4 It's raining./It's snowing.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Join the two words and stress the second (put-ON, take-OFF; PUT-ting-ON, TAY-king-OFF). Do not require native-like speed.
